title: Pure Dinomorphia
summary: Pure Dinomorphia Trap-Fusion control build with generic handtraps and staple Spells. Every Dinomorphia Trap pays half your LP to activate, and once your LP are 2000 or less, Normal Traps banish themselves from the GY to prevent battle damage while Counter Traps prevent effect damage.

summary.title: Starters
points: Dinomorphia Therizia is the primary Normal Summon starter: on Normal or Special Summon it Sets any Dinomorphia Trap directly from the Deck, and when destroyed by battle or card effect it banishes a Trap from the GY to revive a Level 4 or lower Dinomorphia.

Dinomorphia Diplos sends a Dinomorphia card from the Deck to the GY on Normal or Special Summon, burning the opponent for 500 if your LP are 2000 or less, and floats into another Level 4 or lower Dinomorphia when destroyed.
Dinomorphia Domain and Dinomorphia Frenzy are Normal Traps that Fusion Summon a Dinomorphia Fusion Monster during the Main Phase using monsters from your Deck, field, or Extra Deck.

summary.title: Opening: Dinomorphia Therizia + Dinomorphia Frenzy
steps: Normal Summon Dinomorphia Therizia to Set Dinomorphia Frenzy or Dinomorphia Domain directly from the Deck, and Set your remaining Dinomorphia Traps.
During the opponent's Main Phase, activate Dinomorphia Frenzy, paying half your LP, to Fusion Summon Dinomorphia Kentregina using 1 Dinomorphia monster in your Deck and 1 in your Extra Deck.

Use Dinomorphia Kentregina's Quick Effect, paying half your LP and banishing Frenzy or Domain from the GY, to copy that Trap's effect and Fusion Summon Dinomorphia Rexterm using monsters from your Deck.

summary.title: Rexterm Lock & Low-LP Synergy
summary.text: Dinomorphia Rexterm prevents your opponent from activating the effects of any monsters they control whose ATK is greater than or equal to your current LP, and as a Quick Effect on either turn you can pay half your LP so the ATK of all monsters your opponent currently controls becomes equal to your LP. Because every Trap activation and Kentregina activation halves your LP, your LP rapidly drop below every opposing monster's ATK. Dinomorphia Stealthbergia makes you pay no LP to activate Trap Cards or Dinomorphia monster effects while your LP are 2000 or less, and burns the opponent whenever they activate a monster effect.

summary.title: Counter Traps & Recovery
points: Dinomorphia Intact pays half your LP while you control a Dinomorphia card to negate a monster effect and destroy it, and halves all battle damage you take for the rest of the turn when you would take battle damage.
Dinomorphia Sonic sends a Dinomorphia monster you control to the GY and pays half your LP to negate a Spell or Trap activation and destroy it.
Dinomorphia Reversion pays half your LP and banishes a Counter Trap from your GY to copy that Counter Trap's activation effect.

Dinomorphia Alert revives up to two Dinomorphia monsters whose total Levels equal 8 or less (locking you into Dinomorphia Special Summons for the turn), Dinomorphia Brute pops one of your Dinomorphia monsters and one opponent's card, and Dinomorphia Shell summons a 3000-DEF Token that forces all attacks onto itself.
